title: Open Food Log v0: targets
description: The nutrition targets a person keeps: per nutrient a minimum, a maximum or a target, per day or per meal, on some weekdays, from a date. Set by the person (or someone they asked); OFL never prescribes one. How a day is judged against them is section 9 of the spec. v0.1; may change until v1.

id.description: Assigned by the server; used to edit the target.

nutrient.description: A key from nutrients.json, or a producer's x- key.

per.description: day: the total of the person's local day. meal: each meal on its own.

meal_type.description: With per meal: only meals of this type. Absent means every meal.

min.description: At least this much, in the nutrient's unit.

target.description: About this much. Alone, it is met within tolerance_percent either way; with min or max, those decide and this is the point to aim for.

tolerance_percent.description: For a target with no min or max: how far either side of it still counts as met.

weekdays.description: The days it applies, ISO numbered (1 Monday to 7 Sunday). Absent means every day.

effective_from.description: The first local day it applies.

effective_to.description: The last local day it applies. Absent means until replaced.

set_by.description: Who set it: the person, a professional they work with (a dietitian, a coach), or an app's suggestion the person accepted.
